lines.text: Ameerpet metro… ఒక wallet. ₹50,000 cash… ఒక పాప surgery bill.
lines.say: [whispers] Ameerpet metro… ఒక wallet. [tense] యాభై వేలు cash… [quietly] ఒక పాప surgery bill.
lines.act: a stunned low whisper, as if someone might be watching; slows right down on the last two words

lines.text: Nikhil కి EMI రేపే… సరిగ్గా ₹50,000 short! Choice… చివర్లో.
lines.say: [mischievously] Nikhil కి EMI… రేపే. [dramatic pause] సరిగ్గా యాభై వేలు short! [whispers] Choice… చివర్లో.
lines.act: a sly narrator aside to the viewer, leaning hard on the exact amount, dropping to a whisper at the end

lines.text: Police booth లో ఇచ్చేయ్ Nikhil… 11 కి నీ promotion demo!
lines.say: [worried] Police booth లో ఇచ్చేయ్, Nikhil… [firm] eleven కి నీ promotion demo!
lines.act: a hurried, caring voice note from a friend who wants him safe; firm on the word promotion

lines.text: Address Medchal… రెండు గంటలు. Surgery రేపే… టైంకి చేరుతుందా?
lines.say: [thoughtful] Address… Medchal. రెండు గంటలు. [tense] Surgery రేపే… [quietly] టైంకి చేరుతుందా?
lines.act: thinking aloud, calm on the surface, the doubt sharpening on the final question

lines.text: ఇలాంటి dilemmas రోజూ కావాలంటే… follow చేయండి!
lines.say: [warmly] ఇలాంటి dilemmas రోజూ కావాలంటే… [excited] follow చేయండి!
lines.act: a quick, warm aside, light and brisk

lines.text: మీరైతే? A — Medchal. B — police booth. Comment చేయండి!
lines.say: [dramatic pause] మీరైతే? A… Medchal. B… police booth. [excited] Comment చేయండి!
lines.act: a slow, personal question to the viewer, then urgent quiz-host energy
plain and matter-of-fact, one small tired sigh before the cost, no self-pity

lines.text: Nikhil సారు?! మీరా? పైసలు లేకుంటే… రేపు పాప ఆపరేషన్…
lines.say: [gasps] Nikhil సారు?! మీరా? [voice breaking] పైసలు లేకుంటే… రేపు పాప ఆపరేషన్…
lines.act: a frightened, exhausted father at his door, shocked to see a familiar face; voice cracks and trails off unfinished

lines.text: మా office night guard… రోజూ నాకు salute చేసే మనిషి.
lines.say: [stunned] మా office… night guard. [softly] రోజూ నాకు salute చేసే మనిషి.
lines.act: slow realisation, almost to himself, the words sinking in

lines.text: తనకి నా పేరు తెలుసు… నాకు తన పేరు తెలీదు.
lines.say: [quietly] తనకి నా పేరు తెలుసు… [dramatic pause] నాకు… తన పేరు తెలీదు.
lines.act: quiet and ashamed, a long pause before the last half, stress on తెలీదు

lines.text: మీ choice comment లో… ఈ dilemma friend కి పంపండి!
lines.say: [warmly] మీ choice… comment లో. [mischievously] ఈ dilemma friend కి పంపండి!
lines.act: warm and conspiratorial, like daring the viewer to test a friend

lines.text: Follow చేయండి… మీరూ ఆ ID మీద పేరు చూడలేదు కదా?
lines.say: [warmly] Follow చేయండి… [whispers] మీరూ… ఆ ID మీద పేరు చూడలేదు కదా?
lines.act: a warm sign-off that drops into a hushed, knowing whisper, inviting a rewatch

visual_plan: style: FLAT skin for the present-day story (clean commuter palette: metro grey, signal red, phone-UI white; crisp UI cards for SMS / voice note / map). setSkin('paper') ONLY for the 1-s memory insert of the office gate (L3) — the faded cut-paper look marks it as 'last night'. Back to flat from L4. Cast looks per tools/anim2d/cast.md: Nikhil (NIKHIL_OPT, charcoal shirt) wears an office lanyard with a blue badge 'NIKHIL R · TOWER B'; Ananya appears only as a voice-note bubble with her small avatar (teal kurta). Ramulu (new, ~45): lean, grey-flecked thick moustache, navy security-guard uniform shirt with a shoulder flap, tired eyes; at home in L8 he's in the same uniform shirt (just back from the night shift).

L1 hook (0 s, open on the action, no title yet): Ameerpet metro platform, 8:40 AM rush, a train pulling out; a brown wallet on a bench; Nikhil picks it up and opens it — close-up: a fat wad of ₹500 notes with a small '₹50,000' counter ticking up, a folded hospital ESTIMATE slip ('Baby K. Sravya, 6 yrs · Surgery: 14 Nov · Advance ₹50,000'; no hospital name, no phone number), and a plain ID card (our own generic design, NOT an Aadhaar/government look) with a small photo of a man in a guard's cap with a thick moustache, name 'K. RAMULU', address line '…Medchal'. REWATCH CLUE: the name and photo are readable for ~1 s but never zoomed. Title 'A or B? 🤔' + pill 'MORAL DILEMMA' appears a beat later (~1.5 s).

L2 temptation-hold: Nikhil's phone buzzes in his other hand — SMS card slides down: 'EMI due tomorrow 14 Nov · ₹50,000 · A/c balance low'; split close-up: wallet cash on the left, SMS on the right, both '₹50,000' highlighted with the same yellow marker. Gopi small corner cut-out winks; tag 'NIKHIL'S CHOICE AT THE END 👀' stamps on.

L3 option-b: WhatsApp-style voice-note bubble from 'Ananya' with a waveform; a calendar chip '11:00 AM · CLIENT DEMO · promotion review' pulses red. REWATCH CLUE (setSkin('paper') for ~1 s, faded): last night 9 PM at the 'TOWER B' office gate — a guard with the same moustache salutes; Nikhil walks past looking at his phone, never looks up. Back to flat.

L4 option-a: a flat map card: pin 'Ameerpet' → dotted route → pin 'Medchal', label '≈ 2 hrs'; the estimate slip's 'Surgery: 14 Nov' flips up beside the SMS's 'Due: 14 Nov' — SAME DATE pops between them.
L5 follow: animated FOLLOW button pressed by a finger (pop SFX); the metro clock above the platform freezes at 8:41.

L6 comment-countdown: hard split-screen — LEFT 'A · Medchal కి వెళ్ళి ఇవ్వాలి' (Nikhil on a bus, the demo calendar chip turning grey), RIGHT 'B · Police booth' (Nikhil handing the wallet to a metro police booth window, then the wallet sitting in a tray marked 'LOST & FOUND'); a big ticking clock between them; text 'మీరైతే A or B? 💬' + 5 s countdown 5-4-3-2-1 (no voice during the 5 s, clock-tick SFX). Comment bubbles float up (none give away the ending): 'A — surgery రేపే!', 'B — promotion important bro', 'Hospital కి call చేయొచ్చు కదా?', 'A, no doubt', 'B… police వాళ్ళు ఇస్తారు', '🤔'.

L7 reveal: the A panel slides over B; quick montage — Nikhil on a crowded bus past Kompally-style highway signs (generic, no real shop names), his phone showing '11:00 · Demo started' then 'Missed call: Manager'. He stands at a small blue-walled house with a tin gate; knocks.

L8 twist: the door opens — Ramulu in the navy guard shirt, eyes red from no sleep; behind him a 6-year-old girl peeking from a doorway (no hospital visuals, no illness shown). He freezes, recognises Nikhil, both hands to his head; Nikhil holds out the wallet.
L9: a slow push-in; the faded paper memory of the gate salute (from L3) flashes over Ramulu's face for 6 frames, then clicks into sharp flat colour — same man.

L10 take: Ramulu takes the wallet with both hands and touches it to his forehead (gratitude, no ritual detail); Nikhil looks down at his own lanyard badge 'NIKHIL R' — the name Ramulu read every night. Music drops to a single soft synth note.
L11 comment-share: text 'మీ choice: A or B? 💬' then a share-arrow animation sending the reel to a contact card 'Best friend'.

L12 close-loop: end card FOLLOW @_REELRASAM · SUBSCRIBE @REEL_RASAM; on 'ఆ ID మీద పేరు' the frame rewinds fast to the open wallet on the Ameerpet bench with the ID card just out of focus — hard cut to frame 1 so the loop is seamless and the viewer rewatches to find the name.
